n.story:
Your role remains grounded in the physical world, but your 'digital toolbelt' is expanding significantly. While AI cannot climb a ladder or prep a weathered surface for you, it has taken over the tedious task of interpreting complex 2D and 3D blueprints. You no longer spend hours squinting at paper plans; instead, AI-powered overlays show you exactly where different finishes are required and flag potential structural issues before you even open a paint can.

Safety and material selection are where you become a true expert. AI assistants now provide instant chemical compatibility checks and environmental impact assessments for various paint types, ensuring every job is both durable and compliant. You are shifting from a pure laborer to a technical consultant who uses computer vision to guarantee a flawless finish, while robots handle the repetitive, back-breaking tasks like large-scale sanding between coats.
